description: Three actual English/French/Kirundi query batches covered broad month activity, exact 12 December marches, and workers, students, women and regional terms. Search results were mostly unrelated, source snippets and administrative material. Only APRODH body text was relevant; FORSC yielded PDF metadata only. No other qualifying domestic-state demand was established in this bounded method.
required_followup: Further local media and sector searches may be useful for specific weeks or districts; current coverage is not exhaustive and zero verified candidates does not imply no activity.

description: APRODH reports several thousand at the Bujumbura march and separately mentions Gitega without a participant count in the consulted passage. It is not appropriate to transfer or aggregate attendance. December search did not establish whether any excluded action was recurrent or connected to a preceding September onset.
required_followup: If a distinct domestic-state action is later identified in either city, verify its own count, demand, exact onset and neighboring-month episode independently.
